items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: They call him Fuqua, George Fuqua.

ctx.x: With white and colored in there from front?

No, no they didn't have it strictly white. They had tables, they had tables on the side, you know, for customers to sit down, you know, people come in and drink, you know. The women, they had women there hustling drinks for them, you know. And he was a big, big stout fella. He had, he was a big politician too. He had a good jerk in the city here. They call him Fuqua, George Fuqua.

What was a chop house? I always see that in old advertisements for the district. Chop house. Must have been a name for something else. Yeah, I don't know the chop house. Might have just been a restaurant.
